task_summary: Investigate whether Early Dark Energy (EDE) model can alleviate acoustic tension between CMB and BAO measurements
primary_inputs: CMB data from Planck and ACT (temperature, polarization, lensing)
primary_outputs: Constraints on cosmological parameters (Ωm, H0, σ8, etc.)
Goodness-of-fit comparison (Δχ²) for ΛCDM, EDE, w0wa models
Posterior distributions of EDE parameters (f_EDE, log10a_c)
expected_figures: Parameter comparison bar charts with error bars
BAO data points with model predictions
Posterior distribution visualization for EDE parameters
